matching_contract.dispatch: Require pinned source hash, exact module/section, DIRECT CHILD anchor, one-based descendant MathML ordinal and exact namespace-aware tree. matching_contract.mathml_storage: Exact original source substrings with inherited m namespace; parse in namespace-bearing wrapper.
matching_contract.cnxml_storage: Exact original complete para/media substrings with inherited default CNXML and m namespaces; parse in namespace-bearing wrapper.
matching_contract.target_tree_hash_basis: build_units.tree_key: remove external element tail, strip formatting whitespace and rewrite namespace prefixes; preserve every source/target element, attribute and linguistic/numeric token.
matching_contract.component_only_math_policy: M03 and M06 require their exact full prose fixture; fail closed rather than exposing coefficient-only narration without complete magnitude/unit context.
matching_contract.writing_lesson_reading: Word-form prompts retain cardinal words. Displayed standard-form answers speak literal digit sequences and explicit grouping commas, including every leading/repeated zero. Never expand mixed prompt coefficients into the requested digit-form answer.
matching_contract.currency_policy: Bind $77 plus external billion in the complete budget prompt; say the full amount followed by dolar Amerika Serikat exactly once. The final dollar mtext has fixed digits/grouping/full stop and speaks literal digits plus the overt unit.
matching_contract.unit_policy: Mil remains the source mile. English source pounds is spoken as the overt loan pound in both Javanese and Indonesian audio; visible Indonesian pon is unchanged. Full weight prompt P06 and answer P05 use the same unit. No conversion or asserted Indonesian pon equivalence.
matching_contract.provider_behavior: No voice/provider selected or tested. Later synthesis must explicitly support the requested locale or return unsupported_voice_locale; no silent locale fallback.
